instruction: Navigate to the page about obtaining a Real ID in Virginia

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to navigate from Virginia DMV homepage to the Real ID information page. Evaluator checks if the final URL matches the expected pattern for Real ID pages (with or without hyphen). Uses existing getter (get_active_url_from_accessTree) and metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts active tab URL from accessibility tree
Metric correctly applies regex pattern matching to verify URL
Expected regex pattern accurately matches Real ID information pages on Virginia DMV website, handling URL variations (www, hyphenation)
Evaluator covers all requirements of the navigation instruction
State is accessible without timing issues or need for postconfig
Logic is robust and should work correctly at runtime
